A_Phrase_Rules_Only.description: Lookup purely against 65 curated passive-aggressive, hostile, and politeness patterns

B_TFIDF_Unigrams_Only.description: TF-IDF with unigrams only (1, 1), no bigrams, standard TF

C_Sentiment_Features_Only.description: VADER positive, negative, neutral, and compound scores alone

D_Linguistic_Features_Only.description: 28 engineered linguistic features (punctuation, pronouns, capitals, discourse markers)

E_Combined_Classical_Model.description: TF-IDF (1, 2) with sublinear TF and Calibrated Linear SVM (Selected Production Model)

F_Transformer_Only.description: XLM-RoBERTa base fine-tuned on GPU (278M parameters, 16.2 ms latency)

H_Hierarchical_Model.description: Stage 1: Neutral vs Non-Neutral; Stage 2: Passive Aggressive vs Overt Hostile

I_Ensemble_Stacking.description: Soft-voting ensemble of calibrated Linear SVM + phrase prior weights
